entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is just... garbage. It's completely inaccurate. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've been so let down.

I understand your frustration. An accurate heart rate is the whole point of the device. I'd be happy to walk you through a few troubleshooting steps that often resolve sensor calibration issues, or I can transfer you to our technical support team.

Honestly, I just don't have time for all that. I've tried everything I can think of. At this point, I just want my money back. I really needed that money for other things, you know? I trusted the product would work.
I see. So to be clear, you're not interested in troubleshooting and would prefer a refund?
Yes, please. I just want a refund. It feels awful to say, but I'm just done with it.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up your order information. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 36 days ago. One moment while I review our return policy.

Alright, I've checked the policy here. It looks like our standard return window is 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at day 36, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. I was so worried. I really appreciate you helping me.

Of course. We want our customers to be happy. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
